title_zh: 核实改期并安排社区通知

scenario.goal_zh: 核实会议改期消息并约定告知居民的方式。

context_zh: 社区工作人员根据场地确认邮件更正会议通知，避免居民按旧日期到场。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Can I announce the new meeting date now? People are still asking about Monday.

sentences.speaker: Lorna
sentences.text: Let me check the hall confirmation first. Yes, it is booked for Tuesday at seven.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Then the announcement needs to say Tuesday, not just that the meeting has been delayed.

sentences.speaker: Lorna
sentences.text: And mention that the room is still the upstairs hall.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: I will update the notice on the front door and post the same wording in the residents' group.

sentences.speaker: Lorna
sentences.text: Please include the full date as well. I will call the two residents who asked for phone updates.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: All right. I will read the new notice back to you before I post it.
